t: What he was chanting while carrying earth at the Trench
a: اللَّهُمَّ لَوْلاَ أَنْتَ مَا اهْتَدَيْنَا وَلاَ تَصَدَّقْنَا وَلاَ صَلَّيْنَا فَأَنْزِلَنْ سَكِينَةً عَلَيْنَا وَثَبِّتِ الأَقْدَامَ إِنْ لاَقَيْنَا
p: Allāhumma lawlā anta mā-htadaynā wa lā taṣaddaqnā wa lā ṣallaynā. Fa-anzilan sakīnatan ʿalaynā wa thabbiti-l-aqdāma in lāqaynā
m: O Allah, were it not for You we would not have been guided, nor given in charity, nor prayed. So send down calm upon us, and hold our feet firm if we meet them.
